validation: Read fm_tracker for execution evidence and fm_runbook for maintained commands; preserve scene-disjoint splits, frozen AE, checkpoint identity and validation-only selection.
Configuration/serialization mocks may run locally; real checkpoint, raster, smoke/resume and held-out evaluation run in the project container on HPC.
Collect per-run config/checkpoint/split identity, seed, exit status and compact validation/test reports; a submitted array is not a verified result.
Read wm_handoff before selecting the next gate; preserve its selected dataset and checkpoint/code identity, train-only statistics and CHM supervision-only role.
Use wm_preparation for audit/fit and bounded GPU gates, wm_runbook for training/resume; real data, GPU execution and throughput measurements are HPC-only.
Collect the gate report, code/config/container/dataset identities, checkpoint and resume evidence; local mocks do not establish training readiness.
Read geo_skill and geo_context, then canonical pointer and release runbook; preserve frozen memberships and overlap exclusions.
Pure selection/identity mocks may run locally; real allocation, containment, separation, overlap and population audits run on HPC.
Collect parent/exclusion identities, membership/separation/overlap reports and outcome counts. Do not regenerate or promote frozen releases implicitly.
Read tiling_skill and tiling_context for producer contracts, then tiling_hpc for containerized Slurm execution.
Compare CRS semantically while preserving exact dimensions, rotated affine grids, alignment, dtype and nodata. Equivalent/different CRS regression cases require HPC when using GDAL/Rasterio.
Keep local checks to pure mocks/configuration. Collect accepted/rejected/failed counts, manifest and artifact identities and resume/publication evidence from HPC.
Run the focused jev_routing/tests suite using only standard-library fixtures and the fake App Server.
Evaluate expected required sources, false skips, extra reads and workflow confusion with evaluate_routing.py; no live service calls unless --live is explicitly selected.
Use --workers (default SLURM_CPUS_PER_TASK, otherwise 1); actual serial/parallel timing comparisons belong on HPC. Live App Server and Jev compatibility require separate checks.
